notes.TESSCUT: SAP from SPOC FFI TESScut 15x15, bg=median faint-40% pixels; quality mask SPOC default bitmask 0b0101001010111111 plus bit 2048 (straylight); variant TESSCUT_SAP_keep2048 for S108 keeps 2048 (epoch 340 fully 2048-flagged, bkg 1354 vs sector median 98); refs = 3x3 off-target boxes normalised by TARGET median (fraction of target flux)

method: per-event: linear baseline fit in 0.3 d window excluding |dt|<max(dur,cad); depth=baseline-mean(|dt|<max(dur/2,cad/2)); err=1.4826*MAD(OOT)/sqrt(Nin); inverse-variance combine; chi2r=event scatter. Injection: exposure-integrated box 1720 ppm (vet depth), same P/dur, offset U(0.15,0.85)P excl 0.40-0.60P, 200 trials; paired increment = injected minus null at same offset.
